q: 在线国际象棋平台的核心功能需求应该优先覆盖哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core functional requirements should an online chess platform prioritize? (Select all that apply)
options: 基于水平的匹配并创建对局
实时走子并由服务端校验
赛后排行榜和个人排名更新
训练题、复盘分析和锦标赛系统
why: 主线是匹配、实时对局、赛后排名；训练、锦标赛和社交功能都应放到范围外，避免高层设计发散。
why_en: The core product path is matchmaking, real-time server-validated gameplay, and post-game ranking, while training and tournaments stay out of scope.
optionExplanations: 对。匹配是玩家进入系统的第一步，是核心路径起点。
对。服务端校验走子是整套设计的信任基础。
对。排行榜是三大核心需求里最后一环，赛后更新即可。
错。训练、复盘、锦标赛都明确排在范围外，别把设计精力花在这里。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — matchmaking is the first step in the player's path, so it anchors the core flow.
Correct — server-side move validation is the trust foundation of the whole design.
Correct — the leaderboard is the third core requirement, updated after each game ends.
Wrong — training, replay, and tournaments are explicitly out of scope; do not spend design effort there.
options_en: Skill-based matchmaking that creates a game.
Real-time moves validated by the server.
Post-game leaderboard and rank updates.
Puzzles, replay analysis, and a tournament system.
scenario: 面向 1000 万注册用户的象棋平台，45 分钟白板只够撑起一条主线需求。
scenario_en: You have 45 minutes to whiteboard a chess platform for 10M users, so only one main requirement line fits.

q: 由此得到的连接规模，最直接支持哪个架构判断？
q_en: What architecture decision does this connection scale most directly support?
options: 连接数不到 200 万，单台服务器堆足内存和网卡带宽就能扛住
连接数确定后，就不用再考虑单机校验每一步走子的计算开销
百万级连接和状态须分摊到几十到上百台 Game Server
这类持续连接应该整体交给 CDN 边缘节点承载
why: 50万盘×2=100万连接只是起点；这个数量级已经超出单机容量，真正的设计判断是需要多机 fleet 加路由方案，而不是记住这次乘法本身。
why_en: Half a million games times two players gives about one million connections, and that scale is what forces a multi-server game-server fleet rather than a single box.
scenario: 面试官给出规模目标：系统峰值要同时支撑 50 万盘对局，每盘两名玩家各占一条独立 WebSocket 连接，这个连接量还要驱动后续的服务器规模判断。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a scale target: the peak system must support 500,000 concurrent games, with two players per game and one dedicated WebSocket connection per player; this connection count drives later server sizing.
options_en: Connections stay under 2 million, so one server with more memory and NIC bandwidth can handle it.
Once the connection count is known, per-move validation cost no longer matters on a single box.
Million-scale connections and state must be spread across dozens to hundreds of game servers.
This kind of persistent connection should be handled entirely by CDN edge nodes.
optionExplanations: 错，哪怕控制在两百万以内，一百万条常驻连接本身就已经压垮单台服务器能稳定维持的连接和内存上限。
错，连接数解决的是接入层容量，走子合法性校验是每一步都要花的 CPU，两者不能互相替代。
对，百万量级的连接和状态只能靠几十到上百台 Game Server 分摊，单机顶不住。
错，CDN 边缘节点面向可缓存的静态内容分发，扛不住百万级双向持续状态连接。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — even capped under two million, one million persistent connections alone already exceed what a single beefed-up server can hold.
Wrong — knowing the connection count only sizes the access layer; move-legality checking still costs CPU on every move, and neither replaces the other.
Correct — million-scale connections and their state can only be spread across dozens to hundreds of game servers; no single box holds this.
Wrong — CDN edge nodes are built for cacheable static content, not million-scale bidirectional persistent connections.

scenario: 实时对局服务器短暂不可达，系统必须在「让玩家继续操作」和「暂停对局等待恢复」之间取舍。
scenario_en: The live game server is briefly unavailable, and the system must choose between letting players keep moving and pausing the game until recovery.
q: 在线棋局状态的默认取舍应该是什么？
q_en: What should the default tradeoff be for live chess game state?
options: 优先可用性，允许双方客户端各自继续走子
优先一致性，暂停棋局直到服务端恢复
让白方客户端成为临时主节点
直接判掉线方负
why: 棋盘和时钟一旦分叉就很难修复，暂停几秒仍可恢复；因此对局状态应选择一致性高于可用性。
why_en: A paused game is recoverable, but divergent boards are corrupt, so game state should prefer consistency over availability.
whenOtherWins: 若是旁观直播或新闻流这类只读体验，短暂旧数据通常比不可用更可接受，可用性会更重要。
optionExplanations: 错误。各自继续会让两边棋盘分叉，之后没法合并。
对。暂停几秒可恢复，分叉的棋盘没法恢复，所以选一致性。
错误。客户端不可信，不能替代服务端做权威判定。
错误。短暂不可达不等于对局作废，判负太重。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — letting both sides keep moving lets their boards diverge with no way to merge back.
Correct — a brief pause is recoverable, a diverged board is not, so consistency wins here.
Wrong — a client cannot be trusted as the authoritative source of truth.
Wrong — a short outage is not the same as a forfeit-worthy failure.
options_en: Prefer availability, letting both clients keep moving on their own.
Prefer consistency and pause the game until the server recovers.
Promote the white player's client to a temporary primary.
Immediately forfeit the disconnected side.
tradeoff: 一致性（暂停恢复）vs 可用性（各自继续可能分叉）

q: 在线棋局设计里哪些实体是核心建模对象？（多选）
q_en: Which entities are core modeling objects in an online chess design? (Select all that apply)
options: Player，包含身份和评级
Game，包含双方、棋盘、轮到谁、时钟和结果
Move，作为追加式走子历史
Tournament，作为每一盘棋的必需父实体
why: Player、Game、Move 和 MatchRequest 足够支撑匹配与实时对局；锦标赛不在主线需求内。
why_en: Player, Game, Move, and MatchRequest are enough to model matchmaking and live play, while Tournament is outside the core path.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  P[Player]
  MR[Match Request]
  G[Game]
  M[Move Log]
  P --> MR
  MR --> G
  G --> M
optionExplanations: 对。Player 是匹配和排行榜都要用的身份实体。
对。Game 承载棋局的全部实时状态。
对。Move 是恢复和争议仲裁需要的追加历史。
错。核心需求不含锦标赛，Game 不需要挂在 Tournament 下面。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — Player is the identity entity both matchmaking and the leaderboard need.
Correct — Game carries all the live state of a chess match.
Correct — Move is the append-only history needed for recovery and disputes.
Wrong — tournaments are out of core scope, so Game does not need a Tournament parent.
options_en: Player, including identity and rating.
Game, including both sides, the board, whose turn, the clock, and result.
Move, as an append-only move history.
Tournament, as a required parent entity for every game.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量玩家水平的单一数值，赢棋升、输棋降，用来驱动匹配和排行榜。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ELO, or rating, is a single number that rises on wins and falls on losses, driving both matchmaking and the leaderboard.

scenario: 只做匹配和实时对局的象棋平台，要一份能直接落成表结构的最小实体集。
scenario_en: For a chess platform that only does matchmaking and live play, we want the smallest entity set that maps straight onto tables.

q: 补全匹配请求的身份来源：
q_en: Fill in the trusted identity source for a matchmaking request:
text: POST /matchmaking 的 body 只应包含 {{timeControl}} 等偏好；{{playerId}} 和评级必须来自服务端认证上下文和 Player 记录，而不是客户端传入。
why: 客户端可以伪造 userId 或 rating 来挑软柿子，身份和评级必须由服务端可信数据决定。
why_en: The client may lie about identity or rating, so player identity and rating must come from trusted server-side authentication and records.

scenario: 两名玩家在同一盘棋里持续互相发送走子，并且服务端要即时推送确认、对手走子和结束事件。
scenario_en: Two players continuously send moves in the same game, and the server must immediately push acknowledgements, opponent moves, and game-end events.
q: 这条实时对局通道最适合用什么？
q_en: What is the best channel for this live game path?
options: 短轮询 REST
Server-Sent Events
WebSocket
每日批处理同步
why: 棋局是双向、低延迟、持续连接的交互，WebSocket 比单向 SSE 或轮询更贴合。
why_en: A chess game needs continuous low-latency bidirectional messages, so WebSocket is the right protocol.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是服务端向浏览器推送只读价格或评论，SSE 可能更简单；如果实时性不强，轮询也足够。
optionDiagrams:
flowchart TD
  C[Client]
  C -->|poll| S[Server]
  S --> C

flowchart TD
  S[Server]
  S -->|one way| C[Client]

flowchart TD
  A[Player A]
  GS[Game Server]
  B[Player B]
  A <-->|moves| GS
  GS <-->|moves| B
optionExplanations: 错误。轮询间隔会拖慢走子确认，还浪费大量空轮询请求。
错误。SSE 只能服务端推客户端，棋局需要双向发走子。
对。棋局双向、低延迟、长连接，WebSocket 天然匹配。
错误。批处理完全不满足实时对局的时效要求。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — polling intervals delay move confirmation and waste requests when nothing changed.
Wrong — SSE is server-to-client only, but a chess move has to flow both ways.
Correct — a game is bidirectional, low-latency, and long-lived, which is exactly WebSocket's shape.
Wrong — daily batch sync cannot meet a real-time gameplay requirement at all.
options_en: Short-polling REST.
Server-Sent Events.
WebSocket.
Daily batch synchronization.
tradeoff: 双向低延迟长连接（WebSocket） vs 服务端单向推送（SSE）

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持客户端和服务端双向持续通信的协议连接。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WebSocket is a protocol that keeps a persistent two-way connection between client and server.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端单向推送给客户端的轻量协议，客户端不能用它回发消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Server-Sent Events let the server push to the client one-way, without the client sending messages back over it.

q: 一个单局 WebSocket 协议中，服务端通常需要推送哪些消息？（多选）
q_en: Which messages should the server usually push in a single-game WebSocket protocol? (Select all that apply)
options: moveAck，带接受/拒绝和权威时钟
opponentMove，带对手走子和权威时钟
gameEnd，带最终结果
clientRatingOverride，接受客户端声明的新等级分
why: 服务端需要回传走子是否被接受、对手合法走子和结束结果；评级不能由客户端声明。
why_en: The server pushes acknowledgements, opponent moves, and game-end results, while ratings must never be client-declared.
optionExplanations: 对。走子是否被接受，必须由服务端回传确认。
对。对手走子和权威时钟都要推给另一方。
对。对局结束时服务端要广播最终结果。
错。评级绝不能由客户端声明，必须来自 Player 记录。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — whether a move was accepted must be confirmed by the server.
Correct — the opponent's move and the authoritative clock both need pushing to the other side.
Correct — the server broadcasts the final result when a game ends.
Wrong — a rating must never be client-declared; it comes from the Player record.
options_en: moveAck, carrying accept/reject and the authoritative clock.
opponentMove, carrying the opponent's move and the authoritative clock.
gameEnd, carrying the final result.
clientRatingOverride, accepting a new rating the client declares.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持客户端和服务端双向持续通信的协议连接。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WebSocket is a protocol that keeps a persistent two-way connection between client and server.

scenario: 一局对局跑在单条 WebSocket 上，服务端是棋盘、时钟和结果的唯一权威。
scenario_en: A single game runs over one WebSocket, and the server is the only authority on board, clock, and result.

scenario: 每盘棋的棋盘、轮到谁和两个时钟只有几百字节，走子路径要求端到端低于 200ms。
scenario_en: Each game board, turn marker, and two clocks take only a few hundred bytes, and the move path targets under 200ms end to end.
q: 实时棋局状态应该主要放在哪里？
q_en: Where should live chess game state primarily live?
options: 每步都从共享数据库读写 live state
对象存储中的棋盘快照
运行该盘棋的 Game Server 内存
客户端本地作为真相源
why: 棋局状态很小且短生命周期，放在服务端内存能把校验变成本地操作；持久化 move log 用于恢复而不是服务下一步走子。
why_en: Live chess state is tiny and short-lived, so keeping it in the owning game server's memory gives local validation while the move log handles recovery.
whenOtherWins: 如果单个会话状态很大、持续很久，或必须任意服务器无粘性接管，共享存储会更有吸引力。
optionExplanations: 错误。这会把本可几微秒完成的校验变成网络往返，侵蚀 200ms 预算。
错误。对象存储面向大对象批量读写，不适合几百字节的毫秒级更新。
对。状态小且短命，放内存能把校验变成本地操作。
错误。客户端可被篡改，不能作为对局的权威真相。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — this turns a microsecond-cheap check into a network round trip that eats the 200ms budget.
Wrong — object storage is built for bulk data, not a few hundred bytes needing millisecond updates.
Correct — the state is tiny and short-lived, so memory turns validation into a local operation.
Wrong — a client can be tampered with and cannot be the authoritative source of truth.
options_en: Read and write live state from a shared database on every move.
Store board snapshots in object storage.
Keep it in the memory of the Game Server that owns this game.
Treat the client's local state as the source of truth.
tradeoff: 内存持有换低延迟校验 vs 共享存储换无状态可替换

q: 把每一步 live state 都放 Redis/数据库共享读写，最大的热路径代价是什么？
q_en: What is the biggest hot-path cost of putting every live-state update in Redis or a database?
options: 必须使用 GPU 校验走子
每步多一次网络往返，吃掉延迟预算
走子历史将无法持久化保存
排行榜无法按 rating 排序
why: 每次走子都要读当前棋盘并写回新状态，把本来可本地完成的几微秒校验变成网络往返。
why_en: A shared live-state store adds network reads and writes to every move, turning a local validation into hot-path latency.
optionExplanations: 错误。走子校验是简单规则判断，和 GPU 毫无关系。
对。每步都要读当前棋盘再写回新状态，多一次网络往返。
错误。走子历史照样能写进共享存储，问题不在能不能存。
错误。排行榜排序和 live state 放哪无关，是另一套设计。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — move validation is simple rule-checking, unrelated to GPU work.
Correct — every move now reads the current board and writes the new one back over the network.
Wrong — move history can still be written to shared storage; storage capability is not the issue.
Wrong — leaderboard sorting has nothing to do with where live game state lives.
options_en: You would need GPU validation for moves.
Every move pays an extra network round trip that eats the latency budget.
Move history could no longer be persisted.
The leaderboard could no longer sort by rating.
scenario: blitz 走子端到端预算 200ms，服务端本地内存校验一步只要几微秒。
scenario_en: A blitz move has a 200ms end-to-end budget, while in-memory validation on the server takes only microseconds.

q: 将实时棋局放在内存中的决策链，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct decision chain for keeping live chess state in memory?
steps: 选择 stateful Game Server 持有棋盘和时钟
用 durable move log 作为崩溃后的恢复来源
确认每盘状态只有几百字节且生命周期短
要求走子传播低于 200ms
why: 先由低延迟要求和小状态推出内存持有，再用 move log 补上崩溃恢复。
why_en: The low-latency requirement plus tiny game state justifies an in-memory owner, and the move log supplies recovery.
whenOtherWins: 如果每盘状态很大、生命周期很长，或必须任意节点无粘性接管，共享持久状态会更值得考虑。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  L[Low latency moves]
  T[Tiny live state]
  G[Stateful game server]
  M[Durable move log]
  L --> T --> G --> M

q: 服务端收到合法走子后，热路径中应完成哪些动作？（多选）
q_en: After the server receives a legal move, which actions belong on the hot path? (Select all that apply)
options: 校验走子合法且轮到该玩家
更新内存棋盘并切换时钟
先把走子追加到 durable move log
信任客户端发来的剩余时间作为权威值
why: 服务端必须校验、更新权威状态，并在广播前持久化走子；客户端时钟只能用于显示，不能作为真相。
why_en: The server validates the move, updates authoritative state, and persists the move before broadcasting, while client time is only display data.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant G as Game Server
  participant L as Move Log
  participant O as Opponent
  C->>G: move
  G->>G: validate turn
  G->>G: update board clock
  G->>L: append move
  G-->>C: ack
  G-->>O: opponent move
optionExplanations: 对。合法性和轮次是接受走子前的第一道关卡。
对。合法走子要立刻反映到权威棋盘和时钟。
对。广播前先落 durable log，崩溃后才不丢已看到的走子。
错。剩余时间是可作弊值，必须由服务端自己维护。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — legality and turn order are the first gate before accepting a move.
Correct — a legal move must immediately update the authoritative board and clock.
Correct — persisting before broadcast means a crash never loses a move both players already saw.
Wrong — remaining time is a cheat-sensitive value the server must own itself.
options_en: Validate the move is legal and it is this player's turn.
Update the in-memory board and switch the clock.
Append the move to the durable move log first.
Trust the remaining time the client reports as authoritative.
scenario: blitz 对局要在 200ms 内 ack 一次走子，服务端持有权威棋盘与时钟。
scenario_en: A blitz game must ack a move within 200ms, and the server holds the authoritative board and clock.

q: 为什么合法走子要先写 move log，再 ack/push 给双方？
q_en: Why should a legal move be written to the move log before acking and pushing it?
options: 这样可以减少 Redis 缓存走子记录占用的内存
否则崩溃恢复后可能缺少玩家已经看见的走子
这样能避免所有网络延迟
这样排行榜能实时更新
why: 如果先广播再崩溃，恢复出的棋盘会缺少双方已经看到的移动，造成不可接受的状态回退。
why_en: Broadcasting before persistence can make recovery lose a move that both players already saw, corrupting the game state.
optionExplanations: 错误。写入顺序和 Redis 内存占用没有关系。
对。先广播再崩溃，恢复出的棋盘会比玩家实际看到的落后一步。
错误。持久化本身也要花时间，不可能消除全部延迟。
错误。排行榜更新在赛后才发生，与走子持久化顺序无关。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — write ordering has nothing to do with Redis memory usage.
Correct — broadcasting first would let a crash recover a board one move behind what players already saw.
Wrong — persistence itself takes time, so it cannot remove all latency.
Wrong — leaderboard updates happen after the game ends, unrelated to move-persist ordering.
options_en: It reduces the memory Redis uses to cache move records.
Otherwise crash recovery could be missing a move players already saw.
It avoids all network delay entirely.
It makes the leaderboard update in real time.
scenario: Game Server 崩溃后从 move log 重建棋盘，玩家已在屏幕上看到的走子不能消失。
scenario_en: After a crash the Game Server rebuilds the board from the move log, and moves players already saw must not disappear.

q: 补全 live state 与持久化的职责分工：
q_en: Fill in the split between live state and durable storage:
text: 实时棋盘的真相源是 Game Server 的{{内存}}；数据库里的追加式 {{Move log}} 主要用于崩溃后 replay 恢复，而不是服务下一步走子。
why: 这能同时得到低延迟和可恢复性，避免把每步校验绑定到远程存储。
why_en: This split gives low-latency local validation while retaining recoverability through replay.

q: 由这个吞吐量级得出的最直接判断是什么？
q_en: What is the most direct conclusion from this throughput scale?
options: 个位数请求每秒，用单机同步查表就够
这是峰值上限，不用再叠加新玩家和晚高峰
稳态已在千级到万级请求每秒，行级查询加锁的共享表会先撑不住
匹配吞吐只取决于时间控制种类，跟活跃玩家总数和排队频率都无关
why: 100万/120秒≈8千/s 只是稳态下限，叠加新玩家和晚高峰后到万级；这个量级直接说明按行查询加锁的朴素匹配表撑不住。
why_en: One million players re-queuing every 120 seconds is roughly eight thousand requests per second at steady state, a load that breaks a naive locked table before adding new players or evening peaks.
scenario: 面试官给出这些数字：约 100 万活跃玩家，大部分快棋玩家平均每 120 秒就重新排一次队。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives these numbers: about one million active players, and most blitz players re-enter matchmaking about every 120 seconds.
options_en: Single digits of requests per second; a synchronous table lookup is enough.
That is the hard peak, so evening surges and new players need no extra headroom.
Already thousands to tens of thousands of requests per second, which a row-locked shared table cannot sustain.
Matchmaking throughput depends only on the time-control mix, unrelated to both active player count and re-queue frequency.
optionExplanations: 错，100万/120秒算下来已经接近八千每秒，远超个位数，单机同步查表第一个顶不住。
错，这只是稳态下限，晚高峰和新增玩家还会往上叠，不能当成峰值封顶。
对，稳态就有千到万级 QPS，行级加锁的共享表撑不住这个并发。
错，吞吐主要由活跃玩家总数和排队频率驱动，不是时间控制种类决定的。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — one million divided by 120 seconds is already close to 8k requests per second, far above single digits, so a synchronous single-box lookup fails first.
Wrong — that number is only the steady-state floor; evening peaks and new players stack on top of it, so it isn't a hard ceiling.
Correct — steady state alone already sits at thousands to tens of thousands of QPS, more than a row-locked shared table can sustain.
Wrong — throughput is driven mainly by active player count and re-queue frequency, not by which time controls exist.

q: 用共享数据库表按 rating 范围查询 pending requests 时，最危险的竞态是什么？
q_en: When using a shared database table for pending requests by rating range, what is the dangerous race?
options: 玩家 rating 会自动下降
同一等待玩家被两个 matcher 配进两盘棋
数据库表结构里少了一列，存不下 timeControl 字段
赛后排行榜会被重复计算两次
why: 范围搜索后还要 claim 候选人；若 claim 不是原子的，同一个 pending request 可能被多个 worker 读到并匹配。
why_en: Range search plus non-atomic claiming can let multiple workers book the same waiting player into different games.
optionExplanations: 错误。竞态和 rating 数值升降没有任何关系。
对。范围查询后 claim 不是原子的，两个 worker 都能抢到同一个人。
错误。timeControl 只是普通字段，加一列就能存，不存在结构存不下的问题。
错误。排行榜重算发生在赛后，和匹配竞态无关。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the race has nothing to do with a rating value going up or down.
Correct — a non-atomic claim after a range search lets two workers grab the same waiting player.
Wrong — timeControl is an ordinary field; adding a column stores it fine, there's no structural limit.
Wrong — leaderboard recomputation happens after games end, unrelated to matchmaking races.
options_en: A player's rating automatically drops.
The same waiting player gets paired into two different games by two matchers.
The table schema is missing a column, so it cannot store timeControl.
The post-game leaderboard gets recomputed twice.
scenario: 几十个 matcher worker 并行扫同一张 pending requests 表，按 rating 范围找对手。
scenario_en: Dozens of matcher workers scan the same pending-requests table in parallel, searching by rating range.

scenario: 需要按 rating 做范围搜索、按 time control 隔离池子，并让多台 matcher 共享同一个 pending pool。
scenario_en: The system needs rating-range search, separate pools by time control, and one shared pending pool visible to many matcher workers.
q: pending 匹配池最适合用哪种结构？
q_en: What structure best fits the pending matchmaking pool?
options: Elasticsearch 建全文索引，对 pending 请求做相关性检索
S3 里按 time control 各存一份对象列表
单个 matcher 进程内维护一个有序数组
Redis sorted set，按 time control 分 key
why: sorted set 以 rating 为 score，天然支持按分数范围查找、插入和删除；共享 Redis 让 matcher fleet 有同一份视图。
why_en: A Redis sorted set scored by rating supports range lookups, inserts, and removals while giving all matchmakers a shared pool.
whenOtherWins: 如果规模很小且只跑单进程，进程内有序数组更简单；如果需要复杂文本搜索而不是数值范围，搜索索引才有意义。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  P[Player queues]
  Z[Redis sorted set by rating]
  M[Matcher workers]
  G[Create game]
  P --> Z
  M -->|range lookup| Z
  M -->|atomic remove| Z
  M --> G
optionExplanations: 错误。这里要的是数值范围查询，不是文本相关性检索。
错误。S3 面向大对象批量读写，不支持低延迟按分数范围查找。
错误。只在单进程有效，加第二个 matcher 就会有两份不同步的视图。
对。score=rating 天然支持范围查找，且多台 matcher 能共享同一份池子。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — this problem needs numeric range queries, not full-text relevance search.
Wrong — S3 is built for bulk object reads and writes, not low-latency score-range lookups.
Wrong — this only works for one process; a second matcher gets an out-of-sync view.
Correct — scoring by rating gives native range lookups, and a shared Redis pool works across every matcher.
options_en: Build a full-text index in Elasticsearch and query pending requests by relevance.
One object list per time control stored in S3.
An in-process sorted array inside a single matcher.
A Redis sorted set, one key per time control.
tradeoff: 共享可查询的池子（Redis） vs 单进程本地速度（进程内数组）

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 里按分数自动排序的集合结构，支持范围查找。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sorted set is a Redis structure that keeps members ordered by score and supports range queries.

scenario: 一个 blitz 玩家 rating=1512 入队，requestId=req_8a3f，还需要保存 playerId、状态和入队时间。
scenario_en: A blitz player with rating 1512 queues as requestId=req_8a3f, and the system also needs to store playerId, status, and enqueue time.
q: 哪组 Redis 操作能同时满足按 rating 排序候选人、又保存这些字段？
q_en: Which Redis operations both sort candidates by rating and store these fields?
options: ZADD mm:blitz 1512 req_8a3f + HSET mmreq:req_8a3f
LPUSH mm:blitz req_8a3f + GET mmreq:req_8a3f
SET mm:blitz:req_8a3f 1512 + PUBLISH mm:blitz all
SADD mm:blitz req_8a3f + SMEMBERS mm:blitz
why: sorted set 用 rating 排序等待请求，hash 保存 request 的其他字段，两者共同组成可查询、可 claim 的池子。
why_en: The sorted set indexes requests by rating and the hash stores request metadata, forming a searchable and claimable pool.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要 FIFO 队列且不按 rating 搜索，list/stream 可能更合适。
codeSample:
ZADD mm:blitz 1512 req_8a3f
HSET mmreq:req_8a3f playerId 42 rating 1512 status pending enqueuedAt 1718900000
optionExplanations: 对。sorted set 按 rating 排序等待队列，hash 存其余字段，两者配合可查询可 claim。
错误。list 不能按 rating 做范围查找，GET 也读不到一个 list。
错误。SET 每个 key 只存一个值，没法按 rating 做范围排序，也存不下 playerId/status 等其他字段，PUBLISH all 也太粗。
错误。普通 set 不带 score，无法按 rating 范围搜索。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the sorted set orders waiters by rating while the hash holds the rest of the fields, together giving a searchable, claimable pool.
Wrong — a list cannot do rating range lookups, and GET cannot read a list value.
Wrong — SET holds one value per key, so it can't be range-sorted by rating or hold the other fields, and PUBLISH all is too broad.
Wrong — a plain set has no score, so it cannot support rating-range search.
options_en: ZADD into the rating-scored sorted set, plus HSET for the request fields.
LPUSH onto a plain list, plus GET the request key.
SET a per-request key to the rating, plus PUBLISH the change to everyone.
SADD into an unordered set, plus SMEMBERS to read it back.
tradeoff: sorted set + hash 可范围查找可 claim vs 简单结构快但查不了范围

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，把多个字段写进一个 hash 结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HSET is a Redis command that writes multiple fields into a hash.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，把成员按分数加入 sorted set。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZADD is a Redis command that adds a member to a sorted set with a score.

scenario: 多个 matcher 同时看到同一个 pending opponent，必须保证只有一个 worker 真正拿到这个玩家。
scenario_en: Several matcher workers can see the same pending opponent, so exactly one worker must actually claim that player.
q: 哪条 Redis 命令最适合做原子 claim？
q_en: Which Redis command is the best fit for an atomic claim?
options: ZRANGEBYSCORE mm:blitz 1462 1562
PUBLISH mm:req_2c91 matchFound
HGETALL mmreq:req_2c91
ZREM mm:blitz req_2c91
why: ZREM 返回实际删除数量，返回 1 的 worker 赢得 claim，返回 0 的 worker 知道候选人已被拿走。
why_en: ZREM is an atomic claim because exactly one worker removes the member and gets a return value of one.
whenOtherWins: 查找候选人时需要 ZRANGEBYSCORE；通知持有长轮询连接的节点时才用 pub/sub。
codeSample:
# 1 means this worker claimed the player; 0 means someone else did
ZREM mm:blitz req_2c91
optionExplanations: 错误。这只是查找候选人，多个 worker 查到同一个人不代表谁拿到了。
错误。发布通知要等 claim 成功之后，不能替代原子删除。
错误。读字段不会移除候选人，无法防止重复配对。
对。ZREM 返回真正删除的数量，返回 1 的那个 worker 才算赢得 claim。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — this only searches for candidates; multiple workers seeing the same person does not decide who wins.
Wrong — publishing the notification only happens after a claim succeeds; it cannot replace the atomic removal.
Wrong — reading fields does not remove the candidate, so it cannot prevent a double pairing.
Correct — ZREM returns how many members it actually removed, so a return of one is the winning claim.
options_en: ZRANGEBYSCORE to search a rating window.
PUBLISH a matchFound event.
HGETALL to read the request's fields.
ZREM to remove the candidate from the sorted set.
tradeoff: 原子 claim（ZREM） vs 只读查找（ZRANGEBYSCORE）

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，从 sorted set 里删除成员并返回实际删除数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREM is a Redis command that removes a member from a sorted set and returns how many were actually removed.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数范围取出 sorted set 里的成员。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZRANGEBYSCORE is a Redis command that fetches sorted-set members within a score range.

q: 补全极端 rating 玩家等待过久时的匹配策略：
q_en: Fill in the matchmaking strategy for extreme-rating players who wait too long:
text: 匹配窗口应随等待时间逐步{{变宽}}，例如从 ±50 开始，根据 {{enqueuedAt}} 计算可接受范围，而不是一开始就给所有人无限宽窗口。
why: 这能让普通玩家快速得到公平对局，也让高低分极端玩家最终不至于永远等不到人。
why_en: A widening window balances fairness for common cases with eventual matching for rating extremes.

q: 等待玩家的长轮询连接已经断开后才被 claim，worker 应该怎么处理这次配对？
q_en: If the waiting player's long-poll connection is gone before claim, what should the worker do with this pairing?
options: 照常创建游戏，等玩家之后发现
作废配对，把仍等待的一方放回池子
让断开玩家自动判负
把请求永久删除
why: 若等待方已经收不到 gameId，这盘棋会变成孤儿对局；应撤销这次配对并把可用玩家重新入队。
why_en: If the waiting client cannot receive the match, the pairing would be orphaned, so the available player should be returned to the pool.
optionExplanations: 错误。对方永远收不到 gameId，会变成没人知道的孤儿对局。
对。撤销这次无效配对，把可用玩家重新放回等待池继续匹配。
错误。这不是玩家的错，判负对可用一方不公平。
错误。永久删除会让本该继续排队的玩家彻底出局。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — that side never receives the gameId, leaving an orphaned game nobody knows about.
Correct — void the dead pairing and put the still-available player back in the pool to match again.
Wrong — this is not the player's fault, so forfeiting is unfair to the side that is still available.
Wrong — permanently deleting the request removes a player who should still be queued.
options_en: Create the game anyway and let the player find out later.
Void the pairing and return the still-waiting player to the pool.
Automatically forfeit the disconnected player.
Permanently delete the request.
scenario: 等待方用长轮询等 gameId，弱网下这条连接随时可能在 claim 之前断掉。
scenario_en: The waiting player long-polls for a gameId, and on a weak network that connection can drop before the claim lands.

q: 这类容量论证最关键的方法是什么？
q_en: What is the key method in this kind of capacity argument?
options: 只要用 Redis 就默认已经具备水平扩展能力
只要 QPS 到五位数，不管资源类型就要分片
只看平均吞吐，忽略最热的那个 key
换算成瓶颈资源的操作数，对比单节点吞吐上限
why: 把请求数换算成 ops/s 再对比 Redis 单节点数十万 ops/s 的量级，才能定量证明不需要分片；记住这套「换算+对比上限」的方法，比记住某次算出的具体数字更重要。
why_en: The real skill is converting peak requests into the bottleneck resource's operation count and comparing it to that resource's known single-node ceiling, not memorizing one computed number.
scenario: 面试官问「为什么不马上给匹配池分片」，你需要把峰值请求量换算成 Redis 操作量，再和 Redis 单节点已知的吞吐能力做比较。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks why you would not shard the matchmaking pool immediately; you need to convert peak requests into Redis operations and compare that with a known single-node Redis ceiling.
options_en: Using Redis at all already implies horizontal scale, so there is nothing to verify.
Any five-digit QPS number means you must shard, regardless of the resource.
Only look at average throughput and ignore the hottest key.
Convert peak requests into the bottleneck resource's operation count and compare it against that resource's known ceiling.
optionExplanations: 错，Redis 单机本身也有吞吐上限，用了 Redis 不代表已经自动获得水平扩展能力。
错，五位数 QPS 具体压在哪个资源上还没算过，不看资源类型就分片是拍脑袋。
错，只看平均值会漏掉某个 time control 或 rating 桶被打成热点的情况。
对，把峰值请求折算成瓶颈资源每秒要处理的操作数，再看这数字是否落在单节点承受范围内。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a single Redis node still has its own throughput ceiling; using Redis at all doesn't automatically grant horizontal scale.
Wrong — a five-digit QPS figure alone doesn't say which resource it loads; sharding by digit count without checking the resource is a guess.
Wrong — averaging throughput can hide one hot time-control or rating bucket carrying most of the load.
Correct — you turn the peak load into operations per second on whichever resource will bottleneck first, then check that number against what a single node of it can sustain.

scenario: 匹配系统峰值约 30k requests/s、每次约 4 个 Redis 操作，最热 time control 约 50k ops/s，pending pool 低于 100MB。
scenario_en: The matchmaking system peaks around 30k requests per second, each request uses about four Redis operations, the hottest time control is around 50k ops/s, and the pending pool is under 100MB.
q: 此时对匹配池的合理判断是什么？
q_en: What is the reasonable judgment for the matchmaking pool here?
options: 必须立即按 rating band 分片
改用 Postgres 全表扫描找对手
单 Redis 主节点加副本即可，暂不分片
给每个玩家开一个独立队列
why: 单 Redis 节点对 sorted-set 操作有足够余量，分片会引入边界匹配错误和复杂度；先用数字证明不需要。
why_en: The workload fits comfortably on one Redis primary, while sharding adds rating-band edge cases and operational complexity.
whenOtherWins: 若单个 time control 增长到当前数倍、热点 key 接近节点上限，才应考虑拆分或更复杂的分区方案。
optionExplanations: 错误。数字证明单节点还有 4-5 倍余量，分片只会多出边界错误。
错误。全表扫描比 sorted set 查找慢得多，是倒退。
对。峰值算下来的 ops/s 远低于单节点上限，先不分片更简单。
错误。每人一个队列没法做范围匹配，反而更难找到对手。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the numbers show 4-5x headroom on one node; sharding only adds rating-band edge cases.
Wrong — a full-table scan is far slower than a sorted-set lookup; that is a step backward.
Correct — the computed peak ops/s sits well under a single node's ceiling, so staying unsharded is simpler.
Wrong — a queue per player breaks range-based matching, making it harder to find opponents.
options_en: Immediately shard by rating band.
Switch to a full-table scan on Postgres to find opponents.
One Redis primary with replicas is enough; do not shard yet.
Give every player their own dedicated queue.
tradeoff: 先用数字证明单节点够用 vs 提前分片换运维复杂度

termDefinitions.meaning: 针对 Redis sorted set 的增删查命令，单线程 Redis 每秒能处理数十万次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sorted-set operations are the insert, remove, and lookup commands a single-threaded Redis node can serve at hundreds of thousands per second.

q: 匹配池 Redis 主节点故障时，为什么可以接受丢失少量 in-flight pending requests？
q_en: Why is it acceptable to lose a few in-flight pending requests when the Redis primary fails?
options: 因为它们不是棋局状态，客户端可以重试排队
因为 Redis 永远不会丢数据
因为排行榜会自动补偿
因为 move log 里保存了 pending pool
why: pending 匹配请求是短生命周期、可重建的数据；即使故障转移丢掉一小段队列，客户端重新提交即可。
why_en: Pending match requests are ephemeral and retryable, unlike live game state, so a small failover loss is acceptable.
optionExplanations: 对。等待请求短命且可重建，丢一小段队列客户端重新提交就好。
错误。故障转移确实可能丢一小段还没同步的数据，这是前提而非反驳。
错误。排行榜只和已完成对局的 rating 相关，与匹配池无关。
错误。move log 记录的是棋局走子，不是匹配请求。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — pending requests are short-lived and cheap to rebuild, so a client just re-submits after losing a bit of queue.
Wrong — failover can genuinely lose a bit of unreplicated data; that is the premise, not a rebuttal.
Wrong — the leaderboard only relates to completed-game ratings, unrelated to the matching pool.
Wrong — the move log records game moves, not match requests.
options_en: They are not game state, so the client can simply retry queueing.
Redis never loses data.
The leaderboard automatically compensates for it.
The move log stores the pending pool.
scenario: 匹配请求平均只在池子里待几秒，Redis 故障转移会丢掉最近几百毫秒的写。
scenario_en: Match requests sit in the pool for only a few seconds, and a Redis failover loses the last few hundred milliseconds of writes.

scenario: 有几十到上百台 Game Server，每盘棋的两名玩家必须连到同一台机器，且新增/移除机器时尽量少迁移现有对局。
scenario_en: There are dozens to hundreds of Game Servers; both players in a game must connect to the same machine, and adding or removing machines should move as few active games as possible.
q: 最合适的手写路由方案是什么？
q_en: What is the best hand-built routing scheme here?
options: 把每条 WebSocket 随机分给任意服务器
按 gameId 一致性哈希选 owner
按 playerId 分别路由白方和黑方到不同机器
所有对局都固定路由到同一台主服务器
why: 一致性哈希让两名玩家通过同一个 gameId 落到同一 owner，节点变更时只迁移 ring 上一小段 key。
why_en: Consistent hashing by gameId sends both players to the same owner while remapping only a small slice when membership changes.
whenOtherWins: 如果已有 Orleans/Akka 这类 virtual actor 运行时，可用框架目录服务取代手写 ring。
optionExplanations: 错误。随机分配无法保证两名玩家落到同一台机器。
对。同一 gameId 哈希到同一 owner，扩缩容只影响 ring 上一小段。
错误。分开路由两名玩家，他们大概率落在不同机器上。
错误。单台主服务器撑不住几十上百台机器才够的规模。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — random assignment cannot guarantee both players land on the same machine.
Correct — hashing the same gameId to the same owner remaps only a small ring slice on scale changes.
Wrong — routing the two players separately would likely put them on different machines.
Wrong — one fixed primary cannot hold a scale that needs dozens to hundreds of servers.
options_en: Randomly load-balance every WebSocket connection.
Consistent-hash by gameId to pick the owning server.
Route the white and black players separately by playerId.
Pin every game onto one fixed primary server.
tradeoff: 一致性哈希换小范围重映射 vs 简单路由换全量迁移风险

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 key 和节点都映射到同一个哈希环上的路由算法，节点变化只影响环上一小段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps both keys and nodes onto the same hash ring so membership changes remap only a small slice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不持有对局状态、只负责把请求路由到正确 Game Server 的轻量组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateless session router holds no game state itself; it only routes requests to the correct game server.

scenario: session router 需要知道哪些 Game Server 存活，并在服务器停止心跳时自动把它从路由环移除。
scenario_en: The session router needs to know which Game Servers are alive and automatically remove a server from the routing ring when its heartbeat stops.
q: 最适合保存成员关系的组件是什么？
q_en: What component best stores game-server membership?
options: 存一份 S3 上的静态配置文件
每台服务器各自写一份本地 JSON 配置文件
让每个客户端自行维护服务器列表
注册中心里的 ephemeral node
why: ephemeral node 会随心跳消失而自动删除，router watch registry 后可重建一致性哈希环。
why_en: Ephemeral registry nodes disappear when heartbeats stop, letting routers watch membership and rebuild the ring.
whenOtherWins: 如果是少量固定机器且容忍手动运维，静态配置可以暂时够用，但不能自动处理故障。
optionExplanations: 错误。静态文件不会随服务器上下线自动更新，故障要靠人工改。
错误。本地文件不会跨机器同步，router 看不到全局成员变化。
错误。客户端不该背负发现服务端拓扑的职责，也不可信。
对。心跳一停临时节点自动消失，router watch 后立刻重建 ring。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a static file does not update automatically as servers join or leave; failures need manual edits.
Wrong — a local file does not sync across machines, so the router cannot see global membership changes.
Wrong — clients should not own topology discovery, and they cannot be trusted for it.
Correct — the ephemeral node vanishes automatically when heartbeats stop, letting the router rebuild the ring instantly.
options_en: A static configuration file in S3.
Each server writes its own local JSON config file.
Let every client maintain the server list itself.
An ephemeral node inside a service registry.
tradeoff: 自动感知成员变化（注册中心） vs 手动运维简单（静态配置）

q: Game Server 崩溃后的恢复链路，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct recovery chain after a Game Server crashes?
steps: 新 owner 读取 Game 行并 replay moves 重建棋盘
客户端 socket 断开后重连到 router
旧 server 的 ephemeral node 过期，router 重建 ring
新 owner bump generation 成为该 game 的写入者
router 把该 gameId 指到新的 successor server
why: 成员变更先让路由收敛，客户端重连后新 owner 才能通过读行和 replay 接管，并用 generation fence 排除旧 owner。
why_en: Failover starts with membership expiry and rerouting, then clients reconnect, the new owner replays state, and generation fencing establishes ownership.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  F[Server fails]
  D[Detect owner lost]
  N[Choose new server]
  R[Replay move log]

scenario: 旧 Game Server 网络分区后仍活着，新 owner 已接管同一盘棋，必须阻止旧 owner 继续写入 move 和 clock。
scenario_en: An old Game Server is still alive after a network partition, while a new owner has taken over the same game; old-owner writes to moves and clocks must be blocked.
q: 下面 SQL 里最关键的防护字段是哪一个？
q_en: Which field in this SQL is the critical protection?
options: updated_at
turn
generation
white_ms
why: generation 是 fencing token，新 owner 接管时递增；旧 owner 带旧 generation 的事务无法通过条件写。
why_en: The generation is the fencing token that rejects writes from an old owner after a new owner takes over.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有单进程且不存在脑裂写入，generation 可省略；分布式 owner 切换时不能省。
codeSample:
UPDATE games
SET white_ms = :white_ms, black_ms = :black_ms, turn = :turn,
    generation = :gen, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE game_id = :id AND generation <= :gen;
optionExplanations: 错误。它只记录时间，挡不住一个旧 owner 的写入。
错误。turn 只是棋局状态字段，不带任何防护语义。
对。它是所有权变更时递增的计数器，旧值写入会被条件语句拦下。
错误。它是时钟数值，本身不参与哪次写该被接受的判断。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — it only records time and cannot block a write from an old owner.
Wrong — turn is just game state, carrying no protective meaning.
Correct — it is a counter bumped on every ownership change, and the conditional write blocks any stale value.
Wrong — it is a clock value and plays no role in deciding which write should be accepted.
options_en: updated_at.
turn.
generation.
white_ms.
tradeoff: generation fencing 挡旧 owner vs 无防护字段允许脑裂写入

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Generation is a counter bumped on every ownership change, used as a fencing token.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用来拒绝旧持有者写入的递增令牌。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A fencing token is an increasing value used to reject writes from a stale owner.

q: 没有 generation fence 时，Game Server failover 最容易出现什么严重问题？
q_en: Without a generation fence, what severe failure can Game Server failover cause?
options: 两个owner同时写同一盘棋
Redis sorted set变慢
玩家无法查看历史棋谱
旁观直播连接数暴涨
why: 分区但未死的旧 server 可能继续接受走子并写库，与新 owner 同时推进棋局，导致状态分叉。
why_en: Without fencing, a partitioned old server can keep writing while the new owner also writes, causing split-brain game state.
optionExplanations: 对。故障转移换了 owner，但原服务器如果只是网络分区未必真的死，它可能仍在写，于是两份棋盘各自往前走。
错误。sorted set 是匹配池用的结构，和 Game Server failover 无关。
错误。历史棋谱来自 move log，不受 owner 切换影响。
错误。这是旁观扇出层的容量问题，和 failover 一致性无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — failover assigns a new owner, but a merely partitioned old server may not actually be dead and can keep writing, so the two boards advance separately.
Wrong — the sorted set belongs to the matchmaking pool, unrelated to game-server failover.
Wrong — game history comes from the move log and is unaffected by an owner switch.
Wrong — that is a spectator fanout capacity concern, unrelated to failover consistency.
options_en: Two owners write to the same game at once.
The Redis sorted set slows down.
Players cannot view their game history.
Spectator livestream connections spike.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A generation fence uses an incrementing counter to reject writes from an old owner.

q: 玩家自身断线和 Game Server 故障，在时钟处理上的关键区别是什么？
q_en: What is the key clock-handling difference between a player disconnect and a Game Server failure?
options: 无论哪种断线都应该永远暂停时钟
玩家一断线就应立刻重开一局新的
玩家断线继续走时钟；服务器故障才暂停
服务器故障时改由客户端时钟当权威
why: 玩家断线若暂停时钟会被滥用来逃避败局；服务器故障不是玩家责任，应暂停并恢复。
why_en: A player disconnect should not freely pause the clock because it can be abused, while server failure should pause for fairness.
optionExplanations: 错误。永远暂停会被恶意利用来逃避必败局面。
错误。重开一局丢弃了已经下出的所有棋步，代价过大。
对。玩家断线不是系统的错，不该白送暂停；服务器故障不是玩家的错，应该暂停等恢复。
错误。客户端时钟本就是被怀疑的一方，故障时更不能交给它。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — pausing forever can be abused to dodge a losing position.
Wrong — restarting the game throws away every move already played, which is too costly.
Correct — a player's own disconnect is not the system's fault, so it should not earn a free pause; a server failure is not the player's fault, so it should pause and resume.
Wrong — the client clock is the untrusted side to begin with, so a failure is the worst time to hand it authority.
options_en: Both cases should always pause the clock forever.
A player disconnect should immediately restart a new game.
A player disconnect keeps the clock running; only a server failure pauses it.
During a server failure, the client's clock becomes authoritative.
tradeoff: 断线责任在谁 vs 时钟该不该暂停
scenario: 服务端权威计时的 blitz 对局，落后一方可能故意拔网线拖延必输的局面。
scenario_en: In a server-timed blitz game, a losing player may deliberately pull the plug to stall a lost position.

q: 纯一致性哈希路由在扩容 Game Server 时的一个固有瑕疵是什么？
q_en: What inherent flaw does pure consistent-hash routing have when scaling Game Servers?
options: 必须把棋盘存在客户端
无法让两名玩家落同一台机器
无法处理服务器死亡
会迁移一部分健康进行中的棋局
why: ring membership 改变会让一小段 gameId 重映射，即使原 owner 健康也可能触发重连迁移。
why_en: Changing the hash ring remaps a slice of healthy games, causing reconnects even when their original server did not fail.
optionExplanations: 错误。棋盘一直放在服务端内存，客户端从不是真相源。
错误。这正是一致性哈希擅长的事，两名玩家按同一 gameId 落同一台机器。
错误。ephemeral node 过期正是它处理服务器死亡的机制。
对。ring 成员一变，一小段 gameId 就会重映射到新 owner，即便原服务器还健康。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the board always lives in server memory; the client is never the source of truth.
Wrong — putting both players on the same machine is exactly what consistent hashing is good at.
Wrong — the ephemeral node expiring is precisely the mechanism that handles a dead server.
Correct — changing ring membership remaps a slice of gameIds to a new owner even when the original server is still healthy.
options_en: It requires storing the board on the client.
It cannot put both players on the same machine.
It cannot handle a server dying.
It remaps a slice of healthy in-progress games.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 key 和节点映射到同一哈希环的路由算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps keys and nodes onto the same hash ring for routing.

scenario: 上百台 Game Server 按 gameId 一致性哈希路由，扩容时进行中的对局不该被打断。
scenario_en: Hundreds of Game Servers are routed by consistent hash on gameId, and scaling out should not interrupt games in progress.

scenario: 团队已经在 Akka Cluster Sharding 或 Orleans 生态内，想避免扩容时迁移健康棋局，并让目录服务管理 gameId 到 owner 的映射。
scenario_en: The team already uses Akka Cluster Sharding or Orleans, wants to avoid moving healthy games during scale-out, and wants a directory service to manage gameId-to-owner placement.
q: 这时可以用什么替代手写一致性哈希 router？
q_en: What can replace a hand-built consistent-hash router here?
options: 虚拟 actor / stateful sharding 框架
把棋局状态整个存进客户端本地 localStorage 里保存
给每盘棋分配一个独立消息分区
让 CDN 边缘节点缓存这盘棋的实时状态
why: 这类框架把 placement 交给一致性目录或协调器，能只把新游戏分配到新增容量，并仍要求 move log 与 fencing 思路。
why_en: Virtual actor or stateful sharding frameworks provide managed placement while still needing replay-based recovery and fencing.
whenOtherWins: 如果团队没有该生态或需求较简单，手写 router 加一致性哈希足够且更透明。
optionExplanations: 对。这类系统由协调器统一决定每局落在哪台机器，加机器只影响新对局，不会挪动正在进行的健康棋局。
错误。客户端本地存储既不可信也不能被服务端读到，无法做权威状态。
错误。消息分区是顺序投递结构，不是可变棋局状态的存放地。
错误。CDN 面向静态可缓存内容，棋局是要写入的私有实时状态。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a coordinator decides which machine owns each game, so adding capacity only affects new games and never moves a healthy one in progress.
Wrong — client-side storage is untrusted and unreachable by the server, so it cannot hold authoritative state.
Wrong — a message partition is an ordered-delivery structure, not a place to hold mutable game state.
Wrong — a CDN is for static cacheable content, but game state is private and gets written constantly.
options_en: A virtual-actor or stateful-sharding framework.
Store the entire game state in the client's local localStorage for safekeeping.
Assign each game its own message-queue partition.
Let CDN edge nodes cache this game's live state.
tradeoff: 框架托管 placement 换迁移更少 vs 手写 router 换更透明简单

termDefinitions.meaning: 框架自动管理生命周期和位置的分布式对象模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtual actor is a distributed object whose lifecycle and placement the framework manages automatically.

scenario: 玩家分布在不同地区，棋钟必须防作弊，并尽量不惩罚高延迟玩家。
scenario_en: Players are in different regions, and the chess clock must resist cheating while avoiding unfair punishment for high-latency players.
q: 服务端和客户端在计时上的正确职责是什么？
q_en: What are the right timing responsibilities for the server and client?
options: 客户端自己报告剩余时间，服务端不做任何校验照单全收
服务端拥有权威剩余时间，客户端只做平滑显示
双方各算各的，赛后取平均
只按浏览器时间戳决定胜负
why: 棋钟是可作弊的关键状态，必须由服务端权威维护；客户端本地倒计时只是为了显示顺滑。
why_en: The clock is cheat-sensitive authoritative state, so the server owns it and clients only render a smooth local display.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是休闲计时器且无需对抗作弊，客户端本地计时会简单得多。
optionExplanations: 错误。客户端可以谎报，照单全收等于把计时权交给可能作弊的一方。
对。棋钟是可作弊状态，必须服务端权威维护，客户端只负责显示顺滑。
错误。赛后平均没法实时判断谁先超时，公平性也没保证。
错误。浏览器时间戳完全在客户端掌控，等于放弃权威计时。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a client can lie, so accepting it as-is hands timing authority to the potentially cheating side.
Correct — the clock is cheat-sensitive, so the server must own it authoritatively while the client just renders smoothly.
Wrong — averaging after the fact cannot decide in real time who ran out first, and it is not fair either.
Wrong — a browser timestamp is entirely under client control, giving up authoritative timing altogether.
options_en: The client reports its own remaining time, and the server accepts it without any validation.
The server owns the authoritative remaining time; the client only renders a smooth local display.
Each side computes its own time and they average it after the game.
The outcome is decided purely by browser timestamps.
tradeoff: 服务端权威计时防作弊 vs 客户端计时简单但不可信

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统认定为真相、其它副本都要对齐的那份数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Authoritative state is the copy of data the system treats as truth, which every other copy must match.

q: 这个延迟量级最支持哪个棋钟设计判断？
q_en: What clock-design judgment does this latency scale support?
options: 几秒钟的延迟差异看起来很小，服务端完全不用做任何补偿
网络延迟能累积到接近 7 秒，权威计时必须做补偿
只要客户端愿意上报延迟，服务端就该照单全收
这类延迟只影响界面显示，不影响真实计时
why: 170ms×40步≈6.8秒，在3分钟 blitz 里足以决定胜负；这说明服务端权威计时不能对延迟视而不见，需要做补偿而不是照单全收客户端数字。
why_en: One hundred seventy milliseconds over forty moves is close to seven seconds, enough to decide a blitz game, which is why the authoritative clock needs latency compensation rather than ignoring the gap.
scenario: 面试官给出这个数字：玩家 B 比玩家 A 多约 170ms 网络延迟，一局 blitz 双方各走约 40 步。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives this number: player B has about 170ms more network latency than player A, and a blitz game has about 40 moves per side.
options_en: A few seconds of latency difference looks small, so the server needs no compensation at all.
Network latency can add up to nearly seven seconds, so the authoritative clock must compensate for it.
As long as the client reports its own delay, the server should just accept it.
This kind of delay only affects the visual display, not real elapsed time.
optionExplanations: 错，几秒钟看着小，但在 3 分钟 blitz 里已经够翻转胜负，不能假设可以忽略。
对，170ms 延迟乘以约 40 步能累积到近 7 秒，权威计时因此必须做补偿。
错，客户端可以故意谎报或拖慢延迟数据，照单全收等于把计时权交给对方。
错，这不只是界面显示问题，延迟会真实吃掉玩家的计时预算。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a few seconds sounds small, but in a 3-minute blitz game that's already enough to flip the result, so it can't be assumed away.
Correct — 170ms times about 40 moves adds up to nearly seven seconds — enough to swing a blitz result — so the server needs to compensate for it, not just track raw elapsed time.
Wrong — a client can lie about or deliberately delay its reported latency, so accepting it as-is hands over timing control.
Wrong — this isn't just a display issue; the delay genuinely eats into a player's real clock budget.

scenario: 服务端仍要权威计时，但希望给高延迟玩家返还部分网络传输时间，同时避免单次网络尖峰污染估计。
scenario_en: The server still owns authoritative timing, but it wants to credit high-latency players for part of network transit time without letting one spike poison the estimate.
q: 最合理的延迟补偿估计方式是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable way to estimate latency compensation?
options: 完全相信客户端上报的 playedAt 时间戳
只在玩家输棋之后才补偿这段延迟
不管网络状况，给每人固定返还 5 秒
用 ping/pong 测 RTT，取中位数一半
why: ping/pong 与走子解耦，rolling median 比平均值抗尖峰，用 RTT/2 近似单程传输时间。
why_en: Continuous ping-pong measurement with a rolling median estimates one-way latency while resisting spikes.
whenOtherWins: 若完全不在乎地域公平，可只做普通服务端权威时钟；若无对抗性，客户端本地时间戳更简单。
optionExplanations: 错误。客户端可以伪造时间戳，等于放弃反作弊。
错误。补偿是为了公平计时，不该看比赛结果才决定给不给。
错误。固定值不反映真实网络差异，快网玩家反而占便宜。
对。持续测量而不是靠客户端自报，中位数不怕单次抖动，折半估算能大致抵消传输时间。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a client can forge its timestamp, giving up anti-cheat protection entirely.
Wrong — compensation exists for fairness in timing, not something decided by who is losing.
Wrong — a flat credit ignores real network differences and overpays players on fast connections.
Correct — measuring continuously instead of trusting a self-report, the median resists single spikes, and halving it roughly cancels the transit time.
options_en: Fully trust the client-reported playedAt timestamp.
Only compensate for that delay after the player has already lost.
Give every player a flat five-second credit regardless of network.
Measure RTT with ping and pong, then credit half the median.
tradeoff: 度量并封顶补偿 vs 完全信任客户端或完全不补偿

termDefinitions.meaning: 往返时延，一个请求从发出到收到响应所花的总时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RTT, round-trip time, is the total time from sending a request to receiving its response.

termDefinitions.meaning: WebSocket 里用来探测连接和测网络延迟的心跳帧。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ping/pong are WebSocket heartbeat frames used to probe the connection and measure latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取最近若干次采样的中位数，比平均值更抗单次尖峰干扰。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rolling median is the median of recent samples, which resists a single spike better than an average does.

q: 按 measured RTT 返还时间会引入什么滥用风险？
q_en: What abuse risk does crediting measured RTT introduce?
options: 排行榜无法分页
玩家可以修改服务端 monotonic clock
Redis 会丢掉所有 move log
客户端故意拖延 pong 来抬高 RTT
why: 客户端不能伪造服务端时间戳，但可以慢回 pong，让系统误以为网络很慢；因此补偿必须设置上限。
why_en: A client can inflate measured RTT by delaying pong responses, so latency credit must be capped.
optionExplanations: 错误。分页能力和棋钟补偿机制没有任何关联。
错误。monotonic clock 跑在服务端进程里，客户端根本碰不到。
错误。move log 是走子历史，和延迟补偿完全是两回事。
对。故意慢回 pong 会让系统误判网络慢，从而多拿补偿。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — pagination capability has no connection to the clock-compensation mechanism.
Wrong — the monotonic clock runs inside the server process; a client cannot touch it.
Wrong — the move log is move history, an entirely separate concern from latency compensation.
Correct — deliberately delaying the pong tricks the system into thinking the network is slow, earning extra credit.
options_en: The leaderboard can no longer paginate.
Players can modify the server's monotonic clock.
Redis loses all move logs.
The client deliberately delays its pong to inflate measured RTT.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只会前进、不受系统时间调整影响的计时源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A monotonic clock only moves forward and is unaffected by system time adjustments.

scenario: 服务端按 ping/pong 测得的 RTT 返还传输时间，而 RTT 完全取决于客户端回包速度。
scenario_en: The server credits transit time from RTT measured by ping and pong, but that RTT depends entirely on how fast the client replies.

q: 补全服务端权威且补偿延迟的棋钟公式：
q_en: Fill in the server-authoritative, latency-compensated chess-clock formula:
text: 每步扣时约等于服务端 monotonic clock 的 elapsed 减去估计的 {{median_rtt / 2}}，并对单步返还设置约 {{100ms}} 的上限。
why: 这样在平均意义上减少地域延迟惩罚，同时限制故意抬高 RTT 带来的免费时间。
why_en: Subtracting about half the median RTT with a per-move cap reduces geographic latency bias without granting unlimited free time.

q: 公平棋钟的决策链，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct decision chain for a fair chess clock?
steps: 对单步返还设置上限，避免慢 pong 套利
服务端维护权威 remaining_ms 和 last_start_timestamp
用 ping/pong 的 rolling median RTT 估计网络传输
识别普通服务端计时会把网络延迟算进玩家用时
why: 先承认服务端权威计时的公平缺口，再在不放弃权威的前提下估计并封顶补偿。
why_en: The clock design starts by identifying the latency tax, keeps server authority, estimates transit time, and caps abuse.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是非对抗性的休闲计时器，客户端本地时间戳和简单倒计时通常够用。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Server is clock authority]
  B[Measure client latency]
  C[Cap compensation]
  D[Apply move time]
  A --> B --> C --> D

scenario: 全球排行榜只需要取 rating 最高的前 50 名，玩家总数约 1000 万。
scenario_en: The global leaderboard only needs the top 50 players by rating, with about 10 million total players.
q: 这个 top page 的合理基础方案是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable baseline design for this top page?
options: rating 建索引后 DESC LIMIT 50
每次请求扫描全部玩家再重新排序一遍
让每个客户端各自缓存全量玩家列表
改用对象存储，按 rating 命名文件后排序
why: btree 能按 rating 顺序走前几十个索引项，top-N 并不因为总玩家数大就必然慢。
why_en: A btree index can walk the first few highest-rating entries, making top-N cheap even with many players.
whenOtherWins: 若要精确个人排名或极高频 leaderboard reads，Redis sorted set 这样的外部 order-statistics view 更适合。
optionExplanations: 对。btree 按顺序走前几十个索引项就停，跟总玩家数无关。
错误。全表扫描排序是 O(n log n)，玩家越多越慢，白白浪费了索引。
错误。全量列表随时在变，客户端缓存马上过期还占内存。
错误。对象存储没有范围排序能力，文件名排序更是自造复杂度。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a btree walks the first few dozen ordered entries and stops, independent of total player count.
Wrong — scanning and sorting the whole table is O(n log n) and gets slower as players grow, wasting the index entirely.
Wrong — the full list keeps changing, so a client cache goes stale fast and wastes memory.
Wrong — object storage has no range-sort capability, and filename sorting just invents extra complexity.
options_en: Index rating, then read it DESC with LIMIT 50.
Scan every player and re-sort on every single request.
Have every client cache the full player list.
Move to object storage, name files by rating, and sort by filename.
tradeoff: 索引顺序扫描换 O(1) 起步 vs 全表扫描换实现简单

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库常用的有序索引结构，能按顺序快速定位数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A btree is a common ordered database index that can quickly locate data in sorted order.

q: 为什么个人 rank 查询比排行榜首页更难？
q_en: Why is personal rank lookup harder than the leaderboard front page?
options: rank 查询要比 top-N 多渲染一次棋盘画面
top-N 查询完全用不上任何数据库索引
COUNT(*) 要数出排在你前面的所有人
个人 rank 只能靠全文搜索引擎才能实现
why: 普通 btree 提供有序遍历，但不直接给第几名；中位玩家可能要数百万条索引项。
why_en: A btree gives order but not ordinal position, so exact rank may require counting millions of higher-rated rows.
optionExplanations: 错误。rank 是纯数值计算，和渲染棋盘毫无关系。
错误。top-N 恰恰是最能用 btree 索引受益的查询。
对。btree 给顺序不给位置，中位玩家要数几百万条索引项。
错误。全文搜索解决的是文本相关性，不是数值排名。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — rank is a pure numeric computation, unrelated to rendering a board.
Wrong — top-N is exactly the query that benefits most from a btree index.
Correct — a btree gives order but not position, so a mid-pack player needs millions of counted entries.
Wrong — full-text search solves textual relevance, not numeric ranking.
options_en: Rank lookup renders one extra board frame compared to top-N.
Top-N cannot use any database index at all.
COUNT(*) has to count everyone ranked above you.
Personal rank can only be implemented with full-text search.
tradeoff: 有序遍历（btree） vs 位置查询（需要 order-statistics 结构）

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库常用的有序索引结构，能按顺序快速定位数据，但不直接给出位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A btree is an ordered database index that can traverse in sorted order but does not directly return an item's position.

scenario: 1000 万玩家的 Postgres 排行榜，前 50 名和"我排第几"都要 50ms 内返回。
scenario_en: On a 10M-player Postgres leaderboard, both the top 50 and "what rank am I" must return within 50ms.

scenario: 产品只需要显示「大约第 4200 名」这类近似排名，低成本和简单运维比逐人精确更重要。
scenario_en: The product only needs approximate ranks such as "around 4,200th," so low cost and simple operations matter more than exact per-player rank.
q: 最务实的排名结构是什么？
q_en: What is the most pragmatic ranking structure here?
options: 把某个时刻的 rank 写死进客户端代码
给每个玩家单独开一个消息流通道
每次请求都跑一遍全表 group by
按 rating 分桶维护人数，求高档前缀和
why: 几百个 rating 桶即可常数时间估算排名，更新时把玩家从旧桶移到新桶，代价低但不精确。
why_en: Rating buckets make approximate rank cheap by summing counts in higher buckets, trading exactness for simplicity.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确要求精确名次、精确分页和实时 top-N，Redis sorted set 更合适。
optionExplanations: 错误。rank 随时在变，写死进客户端马上就是错的。
错误。消息流通道是顺序投递结构，不适合做计数维护，且每玩家一个也不现实。
错误。group by 全表这么频繁跑，代价比维护桶计数高得多。
对。几百个桶就能常数时间估算排名，代价是近似而非精确。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — rank keeps changing, so hard-coding it into the client is wrong almost immediately.
Wrong — a message stream is an ordered-delivery structure unsuited to maintaining counts, and one per player is unrealistic anyway.
Wrong — running a full-table group by this often costs far more than maintaining bucket counts.
Correct — a few hundred buckets make rank a constant-time estimate, at the cost of exactness.
options_en: Hard-code a rank value into the client.
Give every player their own message-stream channel.
Run a full-table group by on every request.
Keep a per-band player count bucketed by rating and sum the higher bands.
tradeoff: 近似排名换常数时间 vs 精确排名换更重的结构

scenario: 产品要求 1000 万玩家下精确个人 rank 和 top-N，都要在游戏结束后很快更新。
scenario_en: The product requires exact personal rank and top-N for 10 million players, and both should update soon after a game ends.
q: 最合适的外部索引是什么？
q_en: What external index best fits this requirement?
options: Redis sorted set，按 rating 记分排序
Redis list，按更新时间往后追加
Postgres 表里给每个玩家存一个 JSONB 数组字段
S3 上给每个玩家存一个文件
why: Redis sorted set 支持 ZREVRANK 和 ZREVRANGE，以 log 级别工作量回答精确排名和 top-N。
why_en: A Redis sorted set answers exact rank and top-N efficiently with playerId members and rating scores.
whenOtherWins: 若只需近似名次，bucket counts 更便宜；若 Redis 只是派生视图，权威数据仍应留在 completed games/Players 中。
optionExplanations: 对。ZREVRANK/ZREVRANGE 都是 O(log n)，精确排名和 top-N 一起解决。
错误。list 只有插入顺序，取不到按 rating 排序的名次。
错误。JSONB 数组不带索引，算排名要整列扫描。
错误。按文件存没有排序能力，找名次要遍历全部文件。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — ZREVRANK and ZREVRANGE are both O(log n), solving exact rank and top-N together.
Wrong — a list only preserves insertion order and cannot give a rating-sorted position.
Wrong — a JSONB array carries no index, so computing rank means scanning the whole column.
Wrong — one file per player has no ordering, so finding rank means scanning every file.
options_en: A Redis sorted set scored by rating.
A Redis list appended in update-time order.
A JSONB array column in a Postgres table, one entry per player.
One file per player in S3.
tradeoff: sorted set 给精确排名 O(log n) vs 其他结构没有位置查询能力

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低返回某个成员的名次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANK is a Redis command that returns a member's rank in descending score order.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低取出一段成员列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANGE is a Redis command that returns a range of members in descending score order.

scenario: 需要更新玩家 rating 并查询其 0-based 精确名次，排名按 rating 从高到低。
scenario_en: The system needs to update a player rating and query the player's exact 0-based rank, ordered from highest rating to lowest.
q: 哪组 Redis sorted set 命令符合这个需求？
q_en: Which Redis sorted-set commands match this requirement?
options: ZADD chess:ratings 1820 player42，再 ZREVRANK 取名次
LPUSH chess:ratings player42 + LLEN chess:ratings
HSET chess:ratings player42 1820 + HLEN chess:ratings
SET player42 1820 + SCAN chess:ratings*
why: ZADD 更新分数，ZREVRANK 按高分在前返回精确名次；list/hash 无法直接按 score 排名。
why_en: ZADD maintains the score and ZREVRANK returns exact descending rank, which list or hash structures cannot do directly.
whenOtherWins: 若只需要按 playerId 取当前 rating，hash 会更简单；这里需要按 rating 排名。
codeSample:
ZADD chess:ratings 1820 player42
ZREVRANK chess:ratings player42
ZREVRANGE chess:ratings 0 49 WITHSCORES
optionExplanations: 对。第一条命令更新该玩家的 rating 分数，第二条命令直接按降序返回它的名次。
错误。LLEN 只给列表长度，不是某个成员的名次。
错误。hash 能存分数但取不出「第几名」这个位置信息。
错误。SCAN 遍历 key 空间，既慢又给不出排名。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the first command updates the player's rating score, and the second reads back their descending-order rank directly.
Wrong — LLEN only gives list length, not any member's rank.
Wrong — a hash can store the score but cannot answer 'what position is this'.
Wrong — SCAN walks the keyspace, which is slow and gives no rank at all.
options_en: ZADD the new score, then ZREVRANK to read the exact rank.
LPUSH onto a list, then LLEN to count it.
HSET plus HLEN on a hash.
SET a plain key, then SCAN the keyspace.
tradeoff: sorted set 原生排名命令 vs 其他结构要自己算位置

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按分数从高到低返回某个成员的名次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANK is a Redis command that returns a member's rank in descending score order.

q: 这个内存和写入量级支持什么架构判断？
q_en: What architecture judgment does this memory and write scale support?
options: 1000 万玩家的数据量必须提前拆成多个 Redis 集群才够用
GB 级内存和万级 ZADD/s 都在单 Redis 实例的舒适区
这个规模必须换成列式存储才能承载得住
写入量太大，只能靠离线批处理重新计算
why: 10M 成员约 GB 级内存、约 8k ZADD/s 都远低于单实例 Redis 的能力上限；这说明排行榜可以直接复用匹配系统已有的 Redis，不必新增基础设施或分片。
why_en: Ten million members at gigabyte-scale memory and about eight thousand ZADDs per second both sit well inside a single Redis instance's capacity, so the leaderboard can reuse the existing Redis rather than adding new infrastructure.
scenario: 面试官给出这些数字：1000 万玩家的 Redis sorted set 约占 GB 级内存，游戏结束速率约 4k 局/秒（两名玩家各更新一次，约 8k 次 ZADD/s）。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives these numbers: a Redis sorted set for 10 million players takes gigabytes of memory, and finished games arrive around 4k per second, causing about 8k ZADDs per second.
options_en: The data for ten million players must be split across multiple Redis clusters ahead of time.
Gigabyte-scale memory and tens of thousands of ZADDs per second both fit comfortably in a single Redis instance.
This scale must switch to a columnar store to hold up.
The write volume is too high, so it can only be recomputed by offline batch jobs.
optionExplanations: 错，算下来的内存和写入量都还在单实例范围内，还没到必须拆多集群的地步。
对，GB 级内存和万级写入放在一个 Redis 实例里绰绰有余，不用另起新基础设施。
错，列式存储面向大规模分析扫描，不是给这种键值排名结构用的。
错，几千次每秒的写入 Redis 完全实时扛得住，用不着挪到离线批处理。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the computed memory and write volume both still fit a single instance; nothing here forces a multi-cluster split yet.
Correct — the memory footprint and write rate both sit comfortably inside what one Redis node can handle, so there's no need to add anything new.
Wrong — columnar stores are built for large analytical scans, not this kind of key-value ranking structure.
Wrong — a few thousand writes per second is easily real-time work for Redis; there's no need to push it to offline batch.

q: 用 Redis sorted set 做精确排行榜时，同 rating 玩家如果没有确定性 tie-break，会出现什么问题？
q_en: With a Redis sorted-set leaderboard, what happens if equal-rating players lack a deterministic tie-break?
options: Game Server 会丢连接
无法写入 Redis
不能查询 top 50
分页和名次可能抖动
why: 相同 score 的成员顺序若不稳定，翻页和个人名次会看起来跳动；可在 score 或成员排序中加入确定性 tie-break。
why_en: Equal scores need deterministic tie-breaking or pagination and rank can appear to wobble.
optionExplanations: 错误。这是排行榜问题，和 Game Server 连接毫无关系。
错误。写入照常成功，tie-break 只影响读的顺序。
错误。ZREVRANGE 0 49 依然能查，只是同分内部顺序不确定。
对。同分成员顺序不稳定，翻页时同一个人可能一会儿在这页一会儿在那页。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — this is a leaderboard issue, unrelated to Game Server connections.
Wrong — writes still succeed; tie-breaking only affects read ordering.
Wrong — ZREVRANGE 0 49 still works, only the order within a tie is uncertain.
Correct — unstable ordering among equal scores means the same player can appear on different pages between requests.
options_en: The Game Server drops connections.
Redis writes stop working.
You can no longer query the top 50.
Pagination and rank can appear to wobble.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同分时用来决定先后顺序的额外规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tie-break is an extra rule that decides ordering when scores are equal.

scenario: Redis sorted set 排行榜里大量玩家 rating 完全相同，客户端每页翻 50 条。
scenario_en: In a Redis sorted-set leaderboard many players share the exact same rating, and clients page 50 at a time.

q: 为什么 rating/leaderboard 可以设计成派生视图而不是唯一真相？（多选）
q_en: Why can rating and leaderboard be derived views rather than the only source of truth? (Select all that apply)
options: Game result 持久化后包含计算 ELO 所需信息
每局保存开局 rating 快照，delta 可重算
Players row 和 Redis set 都可以通过幂等 apply/reconcile 修复
rating 只存在内存里，重启后无法恢复
why: 真正不可丢的是已完成对局结果；Players.rating 和 Redis 排行榜是加速读的物化视图，能重放修复。
why_en: Completed game results are the durable source of truth, while player ratings and Redis rankings are materialized views that can be replayed.
optionExplanations: 对。结果一落库，delta 就能随时从这条记录推出来。
对。开局快照让每局的 delta 自包含，不用查别的记录。
对。用 gameId 去重重放，加周期性 reconciliation 就能修复漂移。
错。真正的权威值是已完成对局记录，rating 是可以重建的物化视图。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — once the result is durable, the delta can always be derived from that record.
Correct — the starting snapshot makes each game's delta self-contained, no other record needed.
Correct — idempotent replay keyed by gameId plus periodic reconciliation repairs any drift.
Wrong — the real source of truth is completed game records; ratings are a rebuildable materialized view.
options_en: The persisted game result carries everything needed to compute the ELO delta.
Each game stores a starting-rating snapshot, so its delta can be recomputed.
Both the Players row and the Redis set can be repaired via idempotent apply/reconcile.
Ratings only live in memory and cannot be recovered after a restart.
scenario: 已完成对局结果写在持久化的 games 表，rating 和排行榜分别在 Players 行和 Redis 里。
scenario_en: Finished game results live in a durable games table, while rating and leaderboard live in Players rows and Redis.

q: 游戏结束后可靠更新 rating 与排行榜的顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the reliable order for updating rating and leaderboard after a game ends?
steps: 幂等 apply step 更新 Players.rating 和 Redis sorted set
周期性 reconciliation 从 completed games 重算并覆盖派生视图
先把 Game result 持久化为唯一提交点
若 apply 中途失败，用 gameId 去重后重试
why: 提交点应是 Game result；后续物化更新失败也能用 gameId 幂等重试和周期重算修复。
why_en: The game result is the commit point, and materialized rating updates can be idempotently retried and reconciled.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  E[Game ends]
  R[Compute rating delta]
  P[Persist player ratings]
  L[Update leaderboard view]
  E --> R --> P --> L

scenario: 面试官追问 fair play：玩家可能把棋局喂给引擎，但这不是实时走子路径的核心需求。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks about fair play: a player may feed the position into a chess engine, but that is not part of the core real-time move path.
q: 合理的系统边界是什么？
q_en: What is the right system boundary here?
options: 把引擎检测放到实时 move validation 的同步热路径
完全依赖客户端声明没有作弊
把它作为离线 ML/行为分析和人工复核系统
每步都暂停让对手投票
why: 引擎作弊很难从单步实时判定，通常要跨局比较引擎吻合度、用时模式和 rating 历史，再进入复核流程。
why_en: Engine cheating is best handled by offline behavioral and ML analysis across games rather than the synchronous move path.
whenOtherWins: 非法走子和超时必须在实时路径同步校验；反作弊则适合异步分析。
optionExplanations: 错误。单步实时判断根本分不出引擎走法和人类走法，会拖慢热路径又不准。
错误。客户端完全不可信，声明式反作弊等于没有反作弊。
对。跨局比较用时模式、引擎吻合度和 rating 历史，属于异步分析问题。
错误。这会打断实时体验，也不是可靠的作弊判据。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a single move cannot reliably distinguish engine play from human play, and it would slow the hot path for no accuracy.
Wrong — the client cannot be trusted, so a self-declared claim is not anti-cheat at all.
Correct — comparing time patterns, engine-move agreement, and rating history across games is inherently an offline analysis problem.
Wrong — this breaks the real-time experience and is not a reliable cheat signal anyway.
options_en: Put engine detection on the synchronous real-time move-validation hot path.
Rely entirely on the client's own claim of no cheating.
Treat it as an offline ML and behavioral-analysis system with human review.
Pause every move so the opponent can vote.
tradeoff: 异步跨局分析 vs 同步单步实时判定

scenario: 一盘顶级棋手对局有上万旁观者，旁观者只读且几百毫秒延迟可接受。
scenario_en: A top-player game can have tens of thousands of spectators, and spectators are read-only with a few hundred milliseconds of acceptable delay.
q: 旁观流量应该如何接入？
q_en: How should spectator traffic connect?
options: 旁观流量全部直接连到权威 Game Server
用 pub/sub 或树状广播把只读走子分发给旁观者
允许旁观者也能提交 moveAck
每个旁观者都单独开一份对局副本
why: 旁观是读 fanout，不能拖累 1:1 权威对局服务器；validated moves 可异步广播给只读订阅层。
why_en: Spectating is a read fanout problem, so validated moves should be distributed through pub/sub or a fanout layer instead of burdening the authoritative game server.
whenOtherWins: 若只有两名玩家实时交互，权威 Game Server 直接推送即可，无需额外 fanout 层。
optionExplanations: 错误。上万旁观者直连会拖垮负责校验和计时的权威服务器。
对。旁观是只读扇出，走异步广播层，不占用 1:1 对局的资源。
错误。旁观者不是对局参与方，让他们提交走子确认没有意义还有安全风险。
错误。每人一份副本既浪费资源又没必要，旁观者只需要读同一份广播。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — tens of thousands of direct spectator connections would overwhelm the server that also validates moves and runs clocks.
Correct — spectating is a read fanout, so it belongs on an asynchronous broadcast layer, not the 1:1 game path.
Wrong — spectators are not game participants, so letting them submit move acks is meaningless and risky.
Wrong — a separate copy per spectator wastes resources; spectators only need to read the same broadcast.
options_en: Attach all spectator traffic directly to the authoritative Game Server.
Distribute read-only moves through pub/sub or a tree-shaped fanout.
Let spectators also submit a moveAck.
Give each spectator their own separate game copy.
tradeoff: 只读扇出层承载旁观 vs 权威对局服务器直接扛

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一份数据广播分发给大量只读订阅者的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fanout is the pattern of broadcasting the same data to many read-only subscribers.

q: 完成的棋局归档为什么通常比看起来容易？
q_en: Why is finished-game archiving usually easier than it first looks?
options: 归档数据必须一直放在 Redis 内存里永久保存
每盘棋都要存一份完整对局视频
必须每一步都保存整张棋盘图片
一盘棋约等于一串短 move sequence
why: 一盘棋的核心历史就是走子序列；按开局线路查找可先看作对这些序列做前缀范围扫描。
why_en: A finished chess game is mostly its move sequence, which makes archiving compact and prefix-based opening queries natural.
optionExplanations: 错误。归档数据量大且冷，Redis 内存不是合适的长期存储层。
错误。棋局没有视频概念，走子记录本身就足够重放。
错误。逐步截图既浪费存储又不是重放需要的数据形式。
对。走子序列就是几十个字符的字符串，查开局线路是对它做前缀扫描。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — archives are large and cold data, so Redis memory is the wrong long-term storage layer.
Wrong — chess games have no video concept; the move record alone is enough to replay.
Wrong — per-step screenshots waste storage and are not the data shape replay actually needs.
Correct — the move sequence is just a short string, and finding openings is a prefix scan over it.
options_en: Archived data must always live permanently in Redis memory.
Every game needs a full video recording stored.
Every single step needs a full board image saved.
A whole game is roughly one short move-sequence string.
scenario: 要长期留存上亿盘已结束的棋局并支持按开局线路检索，存储成本必须压到最低。
scenario_en: Hundreds of millions of finished games must be kept long term and searchable by opening line, at the lowest possible storage cost.

q: bullet 棋里的 premove 对服务端最关键的要求是什么？
q_en: What is the key server requirement for premove in bullet chess?
options: 对手走子落定后重新校验 premove
直接相信客户端已经校验过合法性
把 premove 当成一条普通聊天消息处理
premove 期间禁止一切时钟更新
why: premove 是玩家在未知对手回复前预先提交的意图，服务端必须在真实局面出现后重新判定是否合法。
why_en: A premove is only valid after the opponent's actual move is known, so the server must validate it then and discard it if illegal.
optionExplanations: 对。真实局面出现前 premove 只是意图，必须在那一刻重新判定合法性。
错误。客户端可被修改，服务端不校验等于放弃权威规则。
错误。premove 是要改变棋盘状态的走子指令，不是展示性消息。
错误。premove 应用后仍要正常计时，禁止更新会破坏公平。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a premove is just intent until the real position appears, so it must be re-validated at that moment.
Wrong — a client can be modified, so skipping server validation abandons authoritative rules.
Wrong — a premove is a command that changes board state, not a display-only message.
Wrong — the clock still needs to run normally once a premove is applied; banning updates breaks fairness.
options_en: Re-validate the premove once the opponent's move lands.
Trust that the client already validated it.
Treat the premove as an ordinary chat message.
Ban all clock updates while a premove is queued.
scenario: bullet 棋每方只有 1 分钟，玩家提前提交 premove 来省掉一个网络往返。
scenario_en: In bullet chess each side has only one minute, so players pre-submit a premove to save one network round trip.

q: 补全实时走子延迟目标：
q_en: Fill in the latency target for real-time move propagation:
text: 在线棋局的走子传播目标是端到端低于 {{200ms}}，因为 bullet/blitz 中每步只有几秒，延迟会直接吃掉玩家棋钟。
why: 这个量级驱动了 WebSocket、内存状态和避免热路径共享存储的设计。
why_en: The sub-200-millisecond target drives the choices of WebSocket, in-memory state, and avoiding shared-store hops on the move path.

scenario: 玩家提交匹配请求后，系统可能要等待另一个合适玩家出现，希望不额外建通知通道也能把 gameId 返回给等待方。
scenario_en: After a player submits a matchmaking request, the system may wait for a suitable opponent and wants to return the gameId to the waiting player without a separate notification channel.
q: 匹配 POST 的合理交互方式是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable interaction model for the matchmaking POST?
options: 立即返回 pending，让客户端每 50ms 轮询一次
只靠发邮件把 gameId 通知给玩家
长轮询，匹配成功或超时才返回
让客户端自己去扫描等待池找对手
why: 长轮询让已等待的玩家在被配对时直接收到 gameId，避免高频轮询和额外实时通道。
why_en: Long-polling lets a waiting player receive the gameId as soon as a match is found without high-frequency polling or a separate realtime channel.
whenOtherWins: 如果平台已有通用通知 WebSocket，匹配结果也可以走该通道；若等待时间极短，普通请求返回也够用。
optionExplanations: 错误。高频轮询浪费大量请求，还是要额外通道通知配对结果。
错误。邮件延迟太高，完全不适合秒级匹配场景。
对。已等待方的长轮询就是被 claim 时完成的那次请求，不用额外通道。
错误。客户端不该也不能直接访问服务端的匹配池。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — high-frequency polling wastes requests and still needs a separate channel to announce the match.
Wrong — email latency is far too high for a matching flow measured in seconds.
Correct — the waiting side's held long-poll is exactly the request that completes when it gets claimed, no extra channel needed.
Wrong — the client should not and cannot access the server's matching pool directly.
options_en: Return pending immediately and have the client poll every 50ms.
Notify the player of the gameId only by email.
Long-poll and only return once matched or timed out.
Let the client scan the waiting pool itself.
tradeoff: 长轮询零额外通道 vs 高频轮询多请求

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端发起请求后服务端先不回应，等有结果或超时才返回的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Long-polling holds a client's request open on the server until there is a result or it times out.

q: 匹配时使用客户端传来的 rating 和读取 Player 记录里的 rating，关键差异是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between using client-sent rating and reading rating from the Player record?
options: 客户端 rating 快但可伪造，服务端可信
两种来源的 rating 完全等价
Player 记录只能给排行榜用，不能拿来匹配
客户端上报的 rating 天然能防作弊
why: rating 影响对手质量，属于可被滥用的数据；服务端可信来源比省一次读更重要。
why_en: Rating affects opponent selection and can be abused, so a trusted server-side rating is worth the lookup.
optionExplanations: 对。省一次读换来的是可被伪造的对手质量，服务端来源更值得那次查询开销。
错误。可信度完全不同，不是等价关系。
错误。Player 记录本就是匹配时读取 rating 的来源。
错误。客户端数据正是最容易被篡改的一环，谈不上防作弊。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — skipping the lookup trades trust for a value that can be forged; a trustworthy server source is worth that extra read.
Wrong — the two differ entirely in trustworthiness, not equivalent at all.
Wrong — the Player record is exactly where matchmaking reads rating from in the first place.
Wrong — client-reported data is the easiest link to tamper with, the opposite of cheat-resistant.
options_en: The client's rating is fast but forgeable; the server's is trustworthy.
The two sources are completely equivalent.
The Player record can only feed the leaderboard, not matchmaking.
A client-reported rating is naturally cheat-resistant.
tradeoff: 服务端可信来源 vs 客户端更快但可被伪造
scenario: 匹配服务每次入队都要判断玩家强度，rating 直接决定他能碰到多弱的对手。
scenario_en: The matchmaker judges strength on every queue-up, and rating directly decides how weak an opponent a player can draw.

q: 赛后更新 ELO 和排行榜时，哪些细节有助于可靠性？（多选）
q_en: Which details help reliability when updating ELO and leaderboard after a game? (Select all that apply)
options: Game 保存双方开局 rating 快照
以 gameId 作为 apply 幂等键
Redis 排行榜可从完成对局重建
只把新 rating 发给客户端，不落库
why: 开局 rating 让 delta 可重算，gameId 去重防止重复应用，Redis 作为派生视图可修复。
why_en: Starting-rating snapshots, gameId idempotency, and rebuildable Redis views make rating updates reliable.
optionExplanations: 对。开局快照让每局 delta 自包含，不用追溯别的记录。
对。用 gameId 去重，重试同一局结果不会重复计入。
对。Redis 只是派生视图，丢了或漂移都能从完成对局重算。
错。不落库等于没有权威记录，一次崩溃就永久丢失这次更新。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the starting snapshot makes each game's delta self-contained without tracing other records.
Correct — deduping by gameId means retrying the same result never double-counts it.
Correct — Redis is only a derived view, so a lost or drifted set can always be recomputed from completed games.
Wrong — skipping persistence leaves no authoritative record, so one crash permanently loses that update.
options_en: The Game row stores both players' starting-rating snapshot.
gameId is used as the idempotency key for the apply step.
The Redis leaderboard can be rebuilt from completed games.
Only send the new rating to the client without persisting it.
scenario: 赛后 ELO 更新走异步 worker，消息可能重投，Redis 排行榜也可能落后于 DB。
scenario_en: Post-game ELO updates run in an async worker where messages can be redelivered and the Redis leaderboard can lag the database.

q: 一次完整在线棋局的主路径，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct main-path order for one complete online chess game?
steps: Game Server 校验走子、更新内存状态、持久化 move log 并推送
赛后持久化 result，再幂等更新 rating/leaderboard
Matchmaking Service 基于 time control 和 rating 找到对手并创建 Game
两名玩家通过 WebSocket 连到同一台 owner Game Server
why: 产品主线是先匹配成局，再进入同 owner 的实时对局，最后用持久结果驱动排名更新。
why_en: The main path is matchmaking into a game, routing both players to the owner server, validating live moves, and applying post-game ratings.
whenOtherWins: 如果只做离线复盘或题库训练，匹配和实时 owner 路由都可以移出主路径。
